description: This file defines an abstract class 'NotificationPreset' which serves as a base for generating notification presets in an Android wearable notifications context. It includes nested class 'BuildOptions' and defines abstract and non-abstract methods related to building notifications and preset characteristics.

classes.name: NotificationPreset
classes.description: An abstract base class for notification preset generators, providing properties for notification titles and texts, and defining methods for building notifications.

classes.name: NotificationPreset.BuildOptions
classes.description: A data holder class encapsulating options for building notifications such as title, text, priority, actions, icons, and behaviors.

methods.name: NotificationPreset(int, int, int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the preset with resource IDs for name, title, and text.

methods.name: buildNotifications
methods.description: Abstract method to create notifications based on the provided context and build options.

methods.name: actionsRequired
methods.description: Indicates whether this preset requires actions.

methods.name: countBackgroundPickersRequired
methods.description: Returns the number of background pickers needed for this preset.
